description.value: The Dam Restaurant & Bar is a community institution in the Slocan Valley that has been welcoming locals and visitors since 1978, now cooperatively owned by the Slocan Valley Co-operative Association. Touring cyclists can refuel on award-winning burgers, fresh salads, and comfort food in an all-ages, family-friendly pub setting. A weekly Sunday open-stage jam session adds a lively cultural draw for those spending time in the valley.
